artifact: DiDi Hong Kong / Taiwan operation-status evidence gate
finance_gate_reason: This is an operation-status proof pass. It adds no sourced route-level annual passenger counts, realized fares/yields, route permission, or sealed route IDs. Taiwan remains blocked for current partner operation.
methodology_notes: Current operation requires dated or live first-party service evidence beyond storefront availability; secondary reporting is corroborative only.
Operation proof is not route demand, fare, yield, or marine permission.
Null is retained for unsupported route-level finance fields and all route IDs.

market_status_gates.scope_supported: DiDi passenger taxi-hailing of Hong Kong taxis; passenger booking workflow and driver-side taxi onboarding are current. A cross-border Guangdong–Hong Kong car booking product is advertised but not permission-verified here.
market_status_gates.scope_not_supported: No inference to a general private-car ride-share operation, platform-specific regulatory approval, route-level demand, or marine-route permission.
market_status_gates.decision: Clear the operation-status gate only for the Hong Kong taxi-hailing product. Keep all route demand and permission fields null unless separately sourced.

market_status_gates.scope_supported: Historical 2018 launch/activity and December 2018 suspension/cessation are supported.
market_status_gates.scope_not_supported: No current first-party passenger service-area page, live booking capability, licensed partner-branded service, or current government operating receipt was found. Taiwan storefront availability of a Hong Kong app is not Taiwan service.
market_status_gates.decision: Keep Taiwan hard-held. Do not publish it as a current DiDi market. Reopen only with a dated primary DiDi, operator-partner, or regulator receipt showing current passenger service.

market_status_gates.scope_not_supported: Current DiDi passenger operation. Existing country-supported Atlas binding is not an exact operation receipt.
market_status_gates.decision: Held regardless, per sealed wave instruction.

market_status_gates.scope_supported: DiDi Mobility Japan currently provides passenger taxi dispatch in the named official service areas, and the live corporate profile names SoftBank Corp. and DiDi Mobility Pte. Ltd. as shareholders.
market_status_gates.scope_not_supported: No inference of DiDi supply on remote island endpoints omitted by the official roster; no route-level passenger demand implied.
market_status_gates.decision: Record current taxi-operation and DiDi–SoftBank corporate status only where the official roster/profile supports it.
